name: What Gives People Feelings of Power
look: A hand-drawn bar chart titled 'WHAT GIVES PEOPLE FEELINGS OF POWER'. A short green bar is labeled MONEY, a slightly longer blue bar is labeled STATUS, and a third, much longer pink bar at the bottom has no label.
text: WHAT GIVES PEOPLE FEELINGS OF POWER
use: The blank third bar gets something tiny and petty that gives people a ridiculous sense of power, far more than money or status, like knowing a secret or controlling the TV remote.
slots: label for the long pink bar: the petty thing that feels most powerful
examples: Being the only one who knows the wifi password
Having the aux cord on a road trip
